Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
For every non-unknown choice, quote the actual current words supporting that
classification, inside the query's supplied unit IDs. Quotes may fold whitespace
but may not change words. Negative alternatives also need actual evidence; mere
absence is insufficient unless the declared operation explicitly asks whether
something appears in the complete supplied window. No extra IDs or fields.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "条款明确允许向接收方的雇员或承包商披露。", "name": "employees_and_contractors"}, {"meaning": "条款明确允许向接收方的雇员披露，但没有同时授权承包商。", "name": "employees_without_contractors"}, {"meaning": "条款明确允许向接收方的承包商披露，但没有同时授权雇员。", "name": "contractors_without_employees"}, {"meaning": "条款没有形成面向接收方雇员或承包商的明确实际披露许可。", "name": "no_express_staff_contractor_permission"}], "examples": [{"choice": "employees_and_contractors", "quote": "employees or contractors of the Recipient", "source": "ContractNLI:78adf3b331962862d6b5becfd6a3eaec7314b1005fc21198f53282c69411f583"}], "name": "authorized_recipient_class", "question": "焦点条款是否构成一项实际披露许可；若是，它明确授权向哪一类接收者披露保密信息？仅依据条款中的明确接收者表述选择。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "recipient_class_18", "operation": "authorized_recipient_class", "unit_ids": [8, 18], "current_units": [{"id": 8, "text": "As used herein, “Recipient” shall mean the Party who has been given “Confidential Information” (as hereinafter defined) by and of the other Party."}, {"id": 18, "text": "The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement."}], "focus_unit_id": 18}]}
